property_summary: For any initialize(...) inputs where _feeRate is within allowed bounds (<=5000), the reference contract sets feeRate to the provided _feeRate; the mutant that omits the assignment can leave feeRate unchanged (e.g., zero), so there exists inputs where feeRate() != _feeRate after initialize.
change_summary: Delete the feeRate assignment statement, leaving feeRate at its prior value (likely zero), changing observed feeRate after initialization.
